findings.summary: System dark-mode preference is ignored.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is visually identical to light mode; the preference probe reports prefers-color-scheme: dark=true while body remains rgb(255,255,255) and computed color-scheme is normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and adapt surfaces and controls with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), while retaining the manual accessibility control.

findings.summary: Page changes are abrupt full-document navigations with no View Transition enhancement.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no view-transition CSS and the representative routes are separate MPA documents.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } for same-origin routes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Carousel interaction is implemented by two JavaScript carousel libraries rather than platform scroll snap.
findings.evidence: The HAR and DOM show Swiper plus Owl Carousel scripts and no scroll-driven CSS; the mobile screenshot shows custom carousel controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Prefer CSS scroll snap and native overflow behavior for carousels, retaining accessible previous, pause and next controls.

findings.summary: The fixed header does not adapt to scroll state.
findings.evidence: DOM styles show a fixed-top header; platform CSS inspection found no scroll-state/container treatment or scroll timeline.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a scroll-state container query or lightweight sticky-header state to reduce chrome after scrolling.

findings.summary: Dropdowns and overlays rely on custom/Bootstrap positioning rather than resilient anchored primitives.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found two custom overlays, no popover/dialog elements, and no anchor positioning CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover with CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks for transient menus where support policy permits.

findings.summary: The login page opens with a fixed app-download banner covering the bottom of the primary flow.
findings.evidence: The 360x800 login screenshot shows a fixed “DigiLocker is better on mobile app” banner occupying the bottom edge before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not show the app promotion until after task completion, or render it inline without covering the form.

findings.summary: Transient UI is built from custom modal/dropdown markup instead of semantic primitives.
findings.evidence: The platform probe counted custom .modal/.dropdown-menu overlays but zero dialog, popover, or details elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Migrate modal flows to dialog and transient controls to popover with declarative light-dismiss and correct focus management.

findings.summary: The home page overflows horizontally on a narrow viewport.
findings.evidence: The 360px layout capture reports scrollWidth 374px and horizontalOverflowPx 14.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the element forcing the 14px overflow and use intrinsic/fluid sizing; verify at 320–400px widths.

findings.summary: Reusable cards and carousels respond only to viewport breakpoints.
findings.evidence: Live CSS inspection found no @container rules or container-type on the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container queries to reusable cards/carousels so they adapt to their actual allocated width.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated on primary controls.
findings.evidence: The focus probe focused header controls and CTAs; computed outline was none and box-shadow none. Several header buttons are only 30x30px.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible treatment and enlarge pointer targets to at least 44 CSS px where practical.

findings.summary: Invalid login input is not exposed as an actionable accessible error.
findings.evidence: Submitting the empty required mobile field yields only the browser validationMessage; aria-invalid and aria-describedby remain absent and the page error region is empty.
findings.suggestedFix: After interaction, show specific inline feedback, set aria-invalid, connect it with aria-describedby, and announce the error.

findings.summary: Cold mobile performance is outside the good Core Web Vitals range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 7.3s and CLS 0.342 (performance score 0.53); the independent trace measured LCP 2.16s, showing substantial run variability but corroborating late visual work.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize and eagerly load the actual LCP image, reserve layout space, and shorten critical resource chains.

findings.summary: Unsized images and late widget/carousel insertion cause visible layout shift.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout observation measured CLS 0.158; Lighthouse measured 0.342 and identifies unsized carousel and accessibility-widget images as culprits. The image audit found 88 of 89 images without dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Set width/height or aspect-ratio on images and reserve fixed space for the accessibility widget and dynamic carousel/card regions.

findings.summary: The critical path includes blocking scripts/styles and ineffective caching.
findings.evidence: HAR shows five VeryHigh-priority parser stylesheets and a synchronous Swiper script in head; many large CDN resources have no cache header. Lighthouse reports a 2.795s longest dependency chain.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer noncritical scripts, inline only critical CSS, consolidate carousel libraries, preload only the LCP asset, and serve versioned CDN assets with long immutable caching.

findings.summary: Two carousel libraries and broad UI bundles are shipped for one landing page.
findings.evidence: HAR records Swiper and Owl Carousel plus jQuery, Bootstrap, Popper, Font Awesome, chatbot and accessibility bundles; script transfer is 207KB and a 158KB icon font is loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Standardize on one lightweight carousel or CSS scroll snap and subset/replace the icon font.

findings.summary: Important controls and images lack accessible names or labels.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports an unnamed accessibility-widget close button, an unlabeled menu checkbox and an image without alt; the image audit found six missing alt attributes. The login mobile field has no associated label.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control a programmatic name, associate a visible label with the phone field, and add meaningful or empty alt text as appropriate.

findings.summary: Landmark, heading, role and focus structure is invalid.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports no main landmark, nonsequential heading order, role=presentation conflicts and tabindex=1. The home page has no h1; content pages also omit main landmarks.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one main landmark, a single descriptive h1 per template, sequential headings, native button roles and DOM-order tabindex=0 behavior.

findings.summary: Image markup is structurally incomplete despite a valid document shell.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse confirms doctype/charset and aspect-ratio rendering, but the dedicated image audit found 88/89 images without dimensions, 11 oversized images and 23 without responsive sources.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic image dimensions and responsive srcset/sizes; correct malformed image/link attributes visible in the rendered DOM.

findings.summary: Chrome records an inspector issue from an embedded third-party response.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse’s inspector-issues audit identifies a cookie issue on the aistore.myscheme.in embedded resource.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the unused embed or correct its cross-site cookie configuration and verify the DevTools Issues panel is clear.

findings.summary: Some links are not crawlable and many icon links have no descriptive text.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports javascript:void(0) anchors; recon enumerates multiple empty-text links and social links implemented as script-triggered placeholders.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href URLs for navigation, buttons for actions, and accessible descriptive names for icon-only links.

findings.summary: robots.txt and sitemap.xml are inaccessible.
findings.evidence: Direct requests to both /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml return HTTP 403 AccessDenied while the page declares index,follow.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a successful robots.txt and sitemap.xml consistent with canonical URLs and indexing intent.

findings.summary: The Content Security Policy permits unsafe script evaluation.
findings.evidence: Header inspection finds a CSP but script-src includes unsafe-eval and style-src includes unsafe-inline, weakening XSS protection on an identity service.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unsafe-eval, migrate inline styles to nonce/hash-backed policy, and narrow wildcard source lists.

findings.summary: The public authentication entry offers phone OTP only, with no phishing-resistant sign-in option.
findings.evidence: The login page exposes only a telephone form; source probe found no navigator.credentials/WebAuthn integration. No permission prompt fires on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey/WebAuthn authentication and recovery alongside OTP, using conditional UI where supported.

findings.summary: Browser defenses are broad rather than least-privilege.
findings.evidence: Although HSTS, nosniff, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are present, CSP frame-ancestors permits numerous wildcard domains and the policy relies on unsafe-eval/unsafe-inline.
findings.suggestedFix: Narrow frame-ancestors to explicitly required origins, remove unsafe directives and consider Trusted Types for the authenticated application.

findings.summary: Custom overlays are not using resilient top-layer and fallback positioning.
findings.evidence: The live DOM contains custom modal/dropdown UI but no dialog, popover or anchor-positioning primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Move overlays to the top layer with dialog/popover, ensure edge-aware positioning and preserve state/focus across DOM changes.

findings.summary: The app-like service is neither installable nor backed by an offline fallback.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found zero service-worker registrations and recon found no web app manifest, despite mobile-web-app-capable metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a valid web app manifest and a service worker that provides an honest offline shell/recovery page without caching sensitive documents.

findings.summary: Unknown routes expose raw infrastructure errors with no recovery.
findings.evidence: A representative bad route renders a bare XML AccessDenied response with no title, navigation, explanation, or route back to DigiLocker.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve branded 404/403/5xx pages with a clear explanation, home/login actions and retry guidance while preserving the correct HTTP status.

findings.summary: The visible language control did not switch locale during the probe and the date remained English.
findings.evidence: After activating the Hindi option and waiting, html lang remained en and “Last Updated” remained in English.
findings.suggestedFix: Ensure language controls reliably change translated content and html lang; format dates and numbers with Intl for the selected locale.

findings.summary: The mobile number field disables autofill and has no label.
findings.evidence: The login probe reports autocomplete=off and an empty labels collection for the required telephone field.
findings.suggestedFix: Use an explicit visible label and the appropriate autocomplete token (tel or tel-national) while retaining inputmode/type=tel.

findings.summary: Landing-page imagery is oversized and uses legacy formats without responsive selection.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 11 oversized images, 21 legacy-format images and 23 images without srcset; four 2280px JPEG banners transfer about 890KB combined.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive variants, provide srcset/sizes, and avoid downloading hidden desktop/mobile duplicates.

findings.summary: A high-value document service exposes no structured agent capability.
findings.evidence: Discoverability shows content is crawlable, but the platform probe found no WebMCP registration and Lighthouse agentic-browsing scored 0.17.
findings.suggestedFix: Consider narrowly scoped, consent-gated agentic forms/tools for document discovery and verification; never expose private documents without explicit user confirmation.

taskList.title: Repair semantic structure, labels and visible keyboard focus
Eliminate layout shift and optimize the LCP image
Harden CSP and authentication with passkeys
Provide humane validation and infrastructure error recovery
Honor system color scheme and retain contrast/reduced-motion support
Publish robots.txt and sitemap, and replace scripted links
Remove narrow viewport overflow and add component-level responsiveness
Replace custom overlays and carousel mechanics with resilient platform primitives
Make the language switch reliable and locale-aware
Add privacy-safe install/offline and agent capability only where justified
